title: Frog reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Frog body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#4CAF50'/>
  <!-- Frog belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#8BC34A'/>
  <!-- Frog head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- Eye bumps -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='38' r='9' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='38' r='9' fill='#66BB6A'/>
  <!-- Eye whites -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='38' r='6' fill='#E8F5E9'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='38' r='6' fill='#E8F5E9'/>
  <!-- Pupils (looking down at book) -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='40' r='3' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='40' r='3' fill='#1B5E20'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='50' r='1.2' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='50' r='1.2' fill='#2E7D32'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M43 56 Q50 61 57 56' stroke='#2E7D32' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Arms holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='66' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#4CAF50' transform='rotate(-30 26 66)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='66' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#4CAF50' transform='rotate(30 74 66)'/>
  <!-- Book left page -->
  <path d='M22 62 L48 58 L48 78 L22 82 Z' fill='#FFECB3'/>
  <!-- Book right page -->
  <path d='M52 58 L78 62 L78 82 L52 78 Z' fill='#FFF8E1'/>
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <line x1='50' y1='58' x2='50' y2='78' stroke='#FF8F00' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Book cover edges -->
  <path d='M22 62 L48 58 L48 78 L22 82 Z' fill='none' stroke='#FF8F00' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M52 58 L78 62 L78 82 L52 78 Z' fill='none' stroke='#FF8F00' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Book text lines (left) -->
  <line x1='27' y1='66' x2='44' y2='64' stroke='#A1887F' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='27' y1='70' x2='44' y2='68' stroke='#A1887F' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='27' y1='74' x2='44' y2='72' stroke='#A1887F' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Book text lines (right) -->
  <line x1='56' y1='64' x2='73' y2='66' stroke='#A1887F' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='68' x2='73' y2='70' stroke='#A1887F' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='72' x2='73' y2='74' stroke='#A1887F' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Frog legs (feet) -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='90' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#43A047'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='90' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#43A047'/>
  <!-- Toes -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='90' r='2' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='91' r='2' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='90' r='2' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='90' r='2' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='91' r='2' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='90' r='2' fill='#388E3C'/>
  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='54' r='4' fill='#F48FB1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='54' r='4' fill='#F48FB1' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
